text: TSA estimates the total cost burden for TSA PreCheck Application Program respondents by multiplying the number of application enrollees by the compensation rate for each respondent. Multiplying the total time burden in hours, 10,192,955, by the loaded wage rate of $36.63, TSA estimates a total hourly cost burden estimate of $373,367,928 for TSA PreCheck Application Program respondents. TSA multiplies the average time burden in hours, 3,397,652, by the hourly rate of $36.63 to estimate an average hourly cost burden of $124,455,976. Table 17 below displays both three-year total hourly cost burden and average hourly cost burden for TSA PreCheck Application Program respondents.
